description: This file defines the EmployeeReportToController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It manages the rendering of the employee report-to interface, fetches reporting methods using a service, and sets up Vue components with relevant data for the front-end.

classes.name: EmployeeReportToController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling employee report-to view, fetching reporting methods, and preparing the Vue component for UI rendering within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of the ReportingMethodConfigurationService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and UI components before rendering. It retrieves the employee number from the request, fetches reporting methods, and sets up the Vue component with the employee ID and reporting methods.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns an array of capability groups relevant for permission checks.
